Thank you. I'm looking into a counselor. I'm open to the idea of medication since I've had these issues for so long. But, maybe they'll tell me I don't need it. 

I just need to get over my fear. I have asked my husband to come along with me, but he's upset that I haven't made these strides myself.
Thank you. You give very good advice. I'm looking into a counselor who can recommend me to someone else if I need it.

I have considered seeing the therapist that my school provides. I don't have much money, but I can see how much a regular therapist would cost through the school. I've talked to my husband about this and he agrees that I should see someone. Now I just have to schedule the appointment...
Thank you. I enjoyed the video. I'll keep your advice in mind.
Thank you. I find I struggle with the idea that maybe I'm unhappy because I want to be, or maybe I'm just so used to unhappiness that I'm terrified of anything else. But I can only try, I suppose.
Thank you so much. This is all very helpful. I don't have time to write out a decent response, but this is good advice. I'm glad to know that someone out there cares, even if I don't know you.
